I run a solo cash‑only practice charging $140 per visit, haven’t raised rates in 18 months, and want to add a premium service line (e.g., longer sessions or on‑call care) at a higher price. Draft a concise, friendly email to existing patients announcing this new option, stating the premium price (suggest $200), key benefits, and how they can enroll. Output only the email body, no subject line.
